accepted_limitations.lipid_panel_internal_feasibility: Infeasible TC/TG/HDL triples are rejected and redrawn (D019); LDL can still sit at the documented 30 mg/dL clip floor (validator WARNING).
accepted_limitations.blood_pressure_age_extrapolation: NFHS-5 source coverage is men<=54, women<=49; older patients use the oldest band held constant (conservative, not invented). Flagged per record via blood_pressure.extrapolated_beyond_source_age_range.
accepted_limitations.family_history: LASI observed for 45+; MODEL-DERIVED (calibrated parent simulation) for 20-44, tagged per record via family_history.derivation (D020).
accepted_limitations.air_quality: 2023 CPCB state annual mean, urban-station-weighted and applied unadjusted to rural patients (flagged per record); null with a reason for 9 unmonitored states/UTs (D021).
